about_the_game:
🐾 Allergies? No worries — this pet care is 100% allergy & paw-friendly! 🐾

5-Minute Setup, Hours of Deep Desktop Serenity!

A calm, soothing desktop pet simulator awaits. Jump right in and enjoy layered progression. Your companion keeps growing as long as your computer is on—unlock new behaviors, decorate rooms and themes, and automate daily routines effortlessly. With regular content updates, this peaceful world keeps getting richer every day.

Build and Manage Your Own Paw World!

Cats, dogs, penguins, horses, jaguars, and many more design unique habitats for over forty species. Each type has its own productivity traits and personality quirks.

Focus, Engage, Collect: Master Your Workflow!

Use the in-game Pomodoro system to stay productive. Create custom presets, track your session stats, and enjoy smart break reminders tailored to your rhythm. A vast lo-fi music library and advanced sound panel are always at your side.

Deeper Care, Smarter Automation

Feed, clean, heal, and show affection. Turn the basic care loop into a layered system: wash your pets, reduce germs with environmental tools, and control the weather with rain or snow. Features like auto-feeding and self-cleaning simplify your routine so you can focus on the bond you build with your animals.

Mini Games: Quick, Clever, Rewarding

Score chases, daily challenges, time trials, and more. Make strategic risk-reward choices using unique cards and modifiers. Earn upgrades and bonuses that directly enhance your long-term progress.

Achievement Sanctuary: Beauty in Every Goal

Our goal is to offer achievements that are challenging to earn yet delightful to look at. The full version will include even richer visual goals. You can also display your completed achievements as collectible stickers inside your in-game notebook.

Found a bug? Tell us about it.
detailed_description:
Tiny Paws × $0.15 Donation is coming Q4 2025

Our promise: for every Steam sale of Tiny Paws, $0.15 USD will be donated to help animals in need. The entire process will be shared transparently on LinkedIn. Play a warm, cozy game and make a difference in the real world!


Tiny Paws is coming in Q4 2025!

I’ve always had a natural bond with animals. After graduation, I decided to combine that passion with my technical side and now I’m developing Tiny Paws solo under UPI Games. Add it to your wishlist and be the first to know when your new desktop friend arrives!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS (64-bit) or equivalent modern distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent (Mesa drivers 20.x or newer)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly on most low-end Linux systems
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or later (SteamOS 3.0 compatible)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 or better (latest proprietary or Mesa
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or better
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for smoother experience
